summary: This video explains how to consistently beat and farm Grave of Rot Stage 19 to get 100% Mythic gear drop rates without needing Stage 20. Fastidious demonstrates a team consisting of Garius, Gillian, Child of Chaos, Hvitar, and Auster. He highlights two critical mechanics: tuning Skill Timings to delay DPS ultimates until after the Colossal Scavenger devours the tank, and utilizing Familiar Fusion to gain substantial attack and damage talent bonuses.

heroes.name: Auster
heroes.note: Provides high Cold damage and Frost synergy to help burst down the boss during devour phases.

heroes.name: Hvitar
heroes.note: Deals massive Cold damage and applies Frost, acting as the primary damage dealer in Frost comps.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Configured to Ice element for Permafrost affinity, providing periodic debuff dispels and Defense Penalty II via Witch's Remains.

heroes.name: Gillian
heroes.note: Provides team-wide healing, Defense Up buffs, and AoE debuff cleansing on her ultimate.

heroes.name: Garius
heroes.note: Serves as the frontline tank to absorb the boss's Devour ability while self-cleansing and stacking defense.

teams.note: Combines 3 Ice / Permafrost and 2 Radiance elemental affinity. DPS ultimates are delayed to 20s–20.5s to burst down 10% boss HP while Garius is devoured.

tips: Aim to farm Grave of Rot Stage 19 instead of Stage 20, as Stage 19 already guarantees maximum 3/3 Mythic gear drop rates.
Use Skill Timing in team setup to delay DPS ultimates to 20s–20.5s so they cast immediately after Colossal Scavenger devours your frontline tank at 18s.
Fuse sub-familiars in the Hatchery to reroll talent bonuses like Thalarin's Resonance or Greenfield's Blessing to boost team damage.
title: Farm This Dungeon And Get Mythic Gear EASILY ⁂ Dragonheir: Silent Gods
